caption:
Every running morning starts at a table like this one. Hot coffee, gallo pinto, fried plantains, and eggs before the trail begins.

On Day 4, breakfast carries you into 25 kilometres and 2,351 metres of descent from Providencia down to Ranchos Tinamú. The first 7 kilometres climb along a forested ridge to 1,910 metres before the path drops toward the river. Down the mountain, families open their kitchen doors with agua dulce, fruit, and empanadas.

The Trail Running Expedition. 6 to 8 athletes. Departures: 5 – 13 December 2026, 20 – 28 February 2027, 7 – 15 August 2027. Details in the bio.
